focus.en: the significance of the research problem

evidence.zh-CN: 目标问题影响广泛，但现有材料只给出有限的需求数据
evidence.en: the target problem has broad impact, but the material provides limited demand evidence

focus.zh-CN: 创新性与既有工作的差异
focus.en: the novelty relative to prior work

evidence.zh-CN: 方案组合了两种已有方法，但尚未证明组合产生新的能力
evidence.en: the proposal combines two existing methods without yet proving a new capability

focus.en: the method and its key assumptions

evidence.zh-CN: 研究设计依赖样本独立性，并计划使用对照实验
evidence.en: the design assumes independent samples and proposes a controlled experiment

focus.en: resources, schedule, and feasibility

evidence.zh-CN: 核心数据尚未获得，里程碑依赖外部合作方
evidence.en: key data is not yet available and milestones depend on an external partner

focus.en: expected impact and failure risk

evidence.zh-CN: 高影响结论建立在未经验证的规模化假设上
evidence.en: the high-impact claim relies on an unvalidated scaling assumption

focus.en: the thesis's central contribution

evidence.zh-CN: 论文提出新流程，但与最接近基线的差异只在附录中说明
evidence.en: the thesis proposes a new workflow, while the closest-baseline difference appears only in the appendix

focus.en: the method choice and its validity conditions

evidence.zh-CN: 方法假设数据平稳，但实验包含明显的时间漂移
evidence.en: the method assumes stationary data although the experiment contains temporal drift

focus.zh-CN: 实验是否支持主要结论
focus.en: whether the experiment supports the main claim

evidence.zh-CN: 平均指标提高，但三个子组中有一个显著下降
evidence.en: the mean metric improves while one of three subgroups declines materially

focus.zh-CN: 结论的局限与外推边界
focus.en: limitations and generalization boundaries

evidence.zh-CN: 样本来自单一机构，尚无跨地区验证
evidence.en: the sample comes from one institution with no cross-region validation

focus.en: how to communicate the evidence chain clearly

evidence.zh-CN: 汇报先给结论，关键假设和证据来源在后续页面才出现
evidence.en: the presentation states conclusions before revealing key assumptions and evidence sources

focus.en: the concept definition and key distinction

evidence.zh-CN: 课程材料区分相关与因果，并给出混杂因素示例
evidence.en: the course material distinguishes correlation from causation and gives a confounder example

focus.en: applying the concept to a new situation

evidence.zh-CN: 新案例改变了样本来源，但保持了相同的评价指标
evidence.en: the new case changes the sample source while retaining the same evaluation metric

focus.zh-CN: 解释推理步骤而非背诵结论
focus.en: explaining the reasoning rather than recalling a conclusion

evidence.zh-CN: 材料给出三步推导，其中第二步依赖隐含前提
evidence.en: the material gives a three-step derivation whose second step relies on an implicit premise

focus.zh-CN: 识别自己最不确定的部分
focus.en: identifying the least certain part of one's understanding

evidence.zh-CN: 示例答案正确，但没有说明结论在哪些条件下会失效
evidence.en: the sample answer is correct but does not state when the conclusion would fail

focus.en: comparing two solution methods

evidence.zh-CN: 两种方法得到相同结果，但计算成本和假设不同
evidence.en: two methods reach the same result with different costs and assumptions

focus.en: requirements, boundaries, and constraints

evidence.zh-CN: 系统需要低延迟，但吞吐量和一致性要求尚未排序
evidence.en: the system requires low latency, while throughput and consistency priorities remain unspecified

focus.en: architecture choice and component ownership

evidence.zh-CN: 方案使用消息队列解耦写入，但没有说明失败重放机制
evidence.en: the design decouples writes with a queue but omits the replay mechanism

focus.zh-CN: 性能、一致性与复杂度权衡
focus.en: performance, consistency, and complexity trade-offs

evidence.zh-CN: 缓存降低延迟，同时引入陈旧读取风险
evidence.en: caching reduces latency while introducing stale-read risk

focus.en: validation strategy and failure scenarios

evidence.zh-CN: 压测覆盖正常流量，但没有模拟依赖超时和重试风暴
evidence.en: load tests cover normal traffic but not dependency timeouts or retry storms

focus.zh-CN: 清晰表达技术决策依据
focus.en: communicating the rationale for technical decisions

evidence.zh-CN: 候选方案列出组件，却没有连接需求、约束和选择理由
evidence.en: the proposal lists components without connecting requirements, constraints, and rationale

focus.en: an accurate description of product capability

evidence.zh-CN: 产品支持批量导入，但单次文件大小和格式受到限制
evidence.en: the product supports batch import with file-size and format limits

focus.zh-CN: 在客户场景中正确使用产品
focus.en: using the product correctly in a customer scenario

evidence.zh-CN: 客户需要审计记录，标准方案要求先启用保留策略
evidence.en: the customer needs audit records and the standard workflow first enables retention policy

focus.zh-CN: 判断产品与需求是否匹配
focus.en: judging product-to-need fit

evidence.zh-CN: 客户要求离线运行，而当前版本依赖云端推理
evidence.en: the customer requires offline operation while the current version depends on cloud inference

focus.zh-CN: 明确能力边界与升级路径
focus.en: stating capability boundaries and escalation paths

evidence.zh-CN: 材料明确禁止承诺尚未发布的合规认证
evidence.en: the material explicitly forbids promising an unreleased compliance certification

focus.zh-CN: 用清晰、不过度承诺的语言回答
focus.en: answering clearly without overpromising

evidence.zh-CN: 客户问题需要先澄清数据量和部署区域
evidence.en: the customer question requires clarification of data volume and deployment region

focus.zh-CN: 先理解客户异议背后的需求
focus.en: discovering the need behind the objection

evidence.zh-CN: 客户说价格高，但同时担心迁移成本和实施风险
evidence.en: the customer says the price is high while also worrying about migration cost and implementation risk

focus.zh-CN: 把需求与可验证价值连接起来
focus.en: connecting needs to verifiable value

evidence.zh-CN: 客户最重要的指标是减少人工复核时间，而不是功能数量
evidence.en: the customer's primary metric is reducing manual review time, not feature count

focus.en: communicating value with evidence

evidence.zh-CN: 试点数据只覆盖一个团队，不能直接外推到整个集团
evidence.en: pilot data covers one team and cannot be directly generalized to the whole group

focus.zh-CN: 回应异议并提出下一步
focus.en: responding to the objection and proposing a next step

evidence.zh-CN: 客户要求保证结果，但材料只允许承诺试点验收指标
evidence.en: the customer requests a guaranteed result while the material allows only pilot acceptance criteria

focus.en: avoiding false promises and manipulation

evidence.zh-CN: 竞争信息未经验证，政策禁止把传闻作为事实陈述
evidence.en: competitive information is unverified and policy forbids presenting rumor as fact

focus.zh-CN: 项目结果与原始目标的差距
focus.en: the gap between project outcomes and original goals

evidence.zh-CN: 核心功能按时交付，但采用率只有目标的一半
evidence.en: the core feature shipped on time but adoption reached only half the target

focus.en: separating facts, explanations, and inferences

evidence.zh-CN: 日志显示错误率上升，但没有数据证明原因是供应商变更
evidence.en: logs show a higher error rate without evidence that the vendor change caused it

focus.en: key decisions and their trade-offs

evidence.zh-CN: 团队为赶进度减少测试范围，并接受了更高回归风险
evidence.en: the team reduced test scope to meet schedule and accepted higher regression risk

focus.zh-CN: 风险识别、所有者与缓解措施
focus.en: risk identification, ownership, and mitigation

evidence.zh-CN: 依赖风险被记录，但没有明确负责人和触发阈值
evidence.en: a dependency risk is recorded without an owner or trigger threshold

focus.zh-CN: 可复用的经验与下一步改进
focus.en: reusable learning and the next improvement

evidence.zh-CN: 复盘提出加强沟通，但没有定义可观察的流程变化
evidence.en: the review proposes better communication without defining an observable process change
